---
title: "R workshops"
---

Four workshops, in the order to take them:

1. [R Introduction](intro.qmd): objects, functions, packages, reading data, basic data manipulation and graphs. For people new to R.
2. R Regression Models: the formula interface, model summaries and predictions, contrasts, and clustered data. *Being converted.*
3. R Graphics: `ggplot2`. *Being converted.*
4. R Data Wrangling: iterating over files, writing functions, regular expressions, reshaping. *Being converted.*

Before any of them, follow the [installation page](install.qmd).
